items.text:
1. ESTABLISH - RESIDENTIAL PERMIT PARKING AREA Y (Eligibility only, no signs)
300 block of Bryant Street includes 461 2nd Street (Supervisor District 6) (Requires approval by the
SFMTA Board) Gerry Porras, [staff email removed — see the order]

The proposed modification would add RPP eligibility to the residents of the 300 block of Bryant Street
includes 461 2nd Street (300 block of Bryant Street between 2nd Street and Rincon Street) so they
can purchase parking permits for their vehicle to park within RPP Area Y
Note: Southeast side of Bryant Street (301 to 353) are already in RPP Area Y.

Public Comments: No comments.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer to forward to the SFMTA Board for final approval and
implementation.

Decatur Street from Bryant Street – East Side (Supervisor District 6)
(Requires approval by the SFMTA Board) Gerry Porras, [staff email removed — see the order]

The proposed modification would add RPP eligibility to the residents of Decatur Street from Bryant
Street with no parking restrictions on the east side, (No Parking 7 a.m. to 6 p.m.), and (No Parking
Any Time) on the west side of the street so they can purchase parking permits for their vehicle to park
within RPP Area U

Public Comments: No comments.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer to forward to the SFMTA Board for final approval and
implementation.
